summary:
Our project seeks to innovate the way science and technology are taught, transforming traditional learning into an interactive experience in which students take on the roles of scientists, explorers, and engineers.

Through an educational space simulator, we aim to spark curiosity and an interest in scientific knowledge, allowing students to explore scenarios inspired by space exploration and face challenges that they must solve using logic, imagination, and critical thinking.

We draw upon real scientific data and knowledge provided by institutions such as NASA, adapting and simplifying this information to make it easier to understand.

In this way, students do not merely learn concepts; they also experiment, make decisions, understand the consequences of those decisions, and develop problem-solving skills.

Our goal is to turn curiosity into learning and to demonstrate that science and technology can also be learned through exploration, experimentation, and construction.
details:
Project by the Cygnus Founders team


Project Name: Last Horizon


Description: Our project is a simulator for junior astronauts, designed to prepare them for a space mission—whether to Mars or the Moon—where countless challenges can arise, such as oxygen depletion, food shortages, plumbing or electrical issues, and various other unforeseen situations.

General Objective: To help young people understand how things function beyond Earth's atmosphere and to show them the wonders of space. The primary goal is to prevent oxygen levels from reaching zero while traveling aboard a spacecraft toward Mars on a mission to explore new planets. Additionally, players must uncover why the spacecraft malfunctioned upon arrival at Mars by searching for clues regarding the cause of the incident on the Red Planet.


Project Specifications:
This simulator supports a small-group mode (for 2 to 3 players), and we are currently exploring ways to implement a full multiplayer mode to make the experience more interactive and engaging. Several tools were used to develop this project, including:
Visual Studio
Gemini
ChatGPT
Claude
